candidate_universe: all 323 training-source compositions, ascending global composition IDs; held-out compositions of the fold are the 'unseen' candidates
score_space: every method emits per-candidate composition log-scores (log-probability scale, float64); exact ties broken by ascending global ID (stable order)

primary_metric.name: H_bal@1 (LOFO-calibrated)
primary_metric.definition: harmonic mean of seen-val micro Top-1 and unseen-val composition-macro Top-1 (each held-out composition weighted equally)
primary_metric.calibration: calibrated stacking: subtract gamma from every candidate that is a fitting composition of the fold. For screening fold f, gamma_f = argmax over the grid of mean H_bal@1 on the other four screening folds (leave-one-fold-out); ties -> smallest gamma

secondary_metrics: micro H@1 and H@5 (official-style image-weighted rates)
AUSUC: area under the seen-micro vs unseen-macro Top-1 curve swept over gamma (gamma-free representation quality)
unseen crop-component and disease-component Top-1 (from the selected composition)
healthy shortcut rate: fraction of unseen-val (all diseased) images whose Top-1 is any healthy composition

improvement_gate.relative_to: the matched control named in each experiment row
requires_all: primary improves in at least 4 of 5 screening folds (paired)
mean calibrated healthy-shortcut rate increases by no more than 5 percentage points

locked_folds: L1..L3 are scored only for the final Stage E recipe(s), with gamma fixed to argmax mean H_bal@1 over all five screening folds; results are reported whatever they show
legacy_fold: D0 (historical 65-composition seed-42 holdout) is diagnostic only and never used for selection; it contains 12 healthy held-out compositions unlike the official unseen set
official_test_policy: no official-test image, filename or label is read by Round 2 development code; any later official evaluation of a Round 2 model is labelled NON-BLIND because the official sets were examined during Round 1
